removed_core_variable.name: minimum_cost_after_reward_risk_filter_for_pivot_target_selection
removed_core_variable.reason: The selector can skip the nearest intact pre-event pivot and choose a materially farther pivot solely to meet the 1.10 after-cost RR floor. The first losing trade traveled more than +5R favorably but reversed before its selected 8.29 after-cost-R target; a nearer intact pivot existed. This ablation tests whether target skipping, rather than breakout direction, is the dominant failure.

unchanged: first week and immutable source data
first breach consumes each level once
old level held from the accepted side
nearest intact pre-event five-minute pivot ordering
stop invalidation inside the old boundary
decision_rule: A structural path exists only if using the nearest intact pivot without the minimum-RR skip produces repeated independent positive after-cost expectancy across at least two level sources and materially approaches the original weekly gates. Otherwise discard v94 after this one ablation.
